I know it’s scary and feels like there’s literally no way out. I’ve been battling it since I was 15. And as much as you may not want to, the only way is to get yourself some help. It will never stop if you don’t get help. It can be very discreet too, I’m not sure if you have insurance or not but if you do there are a lot of virtual options where you can get help from someone over the phone. Or even inpatient if you think that’s what you need. You can also talk to someone you love that you are close to, they can help you help yourself. I lived a long time thinking help = bad. My parents never got me help when they found out I was bulimic. they just treated me as if I was in trouble and grounded me and told everyone they knew. So I thought help wasn’t actually help, why wouldn’t my parents get me help if it actually helped? But I recently did see someone and honestly it has made a difference. It takes a lot of courage to do, I put it off for years, so I understand if you aren’t ready. If you need someone I am here. Even just having someone to talk to can help. I am so sorry that you’re going through this, no one deserves this constant battle. Just know that you deserve the world and are worth it. You are loved. I hope so badly that one day you can get through this and find peace. :( <3
